metadata.title: Retro Studio Portrait with Neon Script

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast male portrait set against a dark, warm-lit studio background featuring bold yellow serif headers and vibrant pink hand-drawn marker script.
triggerTerms: yellow serif header with pink marker script
warm rim-lit portrait on dark background
excludeWhen: cool-toned or high-key lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a dark shirt, positioned on the right side of the frame, looking toward the viewer. The background is a dimly lit, warm studio or stage environment with bokeh highlights. The composition is anchored by large, bold yellow serif typography at the top left and a vibrant, messy pink marker-style script at the bottom left.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the structured yellow serif and the chaotic pink script
Warm rim lighting on the subject against a deep black background
Triangular balance between the subject's face and the two text blocks
Film grain texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Vibrant yellow and hot pink color accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly angled toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright yellow display type at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow header, moves down to the pink script, then across to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background provide significant negative space for the text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark browns (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and yellow (lighting and header text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with saturated accents against a low-value, desaturated background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and expressive gestural script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Thick vertical strokes, thin horizontal strokes, sharp serifs
Script: Variable pressure marker strokes, overlapping letters, jagged edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning in the serif header where serifs almost touch
Underlining flourish in the script text

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays dark background and subject's arm

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal, rigid serif paired with chaotic, informal marker script for high energy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast bold serif look of the header
Approximates the raw, hand-drawn feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in a black t-shirt, lit with warm amber rim light against a dark, out-of-focus studio background with warm bokeh. Apply a heavy film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold yellow serif text in the top left corner, stacked tightly. Add a vibrant pink hand-drawn marker script in the bottom left corner with a jagged underline.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow text a high-contrast serif?
Is the pink text a messy, hand-drawn script?
Is the lighting high-contrast with warm highlights?
Is there a visible film grain texture across the whole image?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink script color
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Bruce Willis'
Do not use the specific title 'The Return of Bruno'
Avoid exact replication of the subject's facial features

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between the two text styles

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink script looks hand-drawn, not like a standard font
Check that the yellow text is perfectly legible against the dark background
Confirm the subject is positioned to the right to allow space for text
Verify the presence of film grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Warm Portrait] + [Bold Yellow Serif Header] + [Vibrant Pink Marker Script] + [Heavy Film Grain].
